description:
Delete the executor's copies of the dangling-link, enforcement-drift and review-placeholder passes together with their unit tests.

## Background

- `dangling_link_findings` (`crates/jit/src/commands/validate.rs:1239-1331`), `enforcement_drift_findings` (`:1333-1385`), `compute_drift_findings` (`:1387-1440`), `loadable_rule_names` (`:1442-1474`) and `review_placeholder_findings` (`:1695-1734`) have no production caller once the views, the invariant check and the gate checkers read the report. They are public, so the build does not flag them.
- Their unit tests (`commands/validate.rs:3009-3326`) have counterparts against the report's passes in `crates/jit/src/validation/repository.rs`.
- The rustdoc of `crates/jit/src/validation/graph.rs:76-96` names `dangling_link_findings` as a resolution path.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: The five listed methods and their unit tests no longer exist, and no executor method computes dangling-link, drift or placeholder findings.
- [hard] REQ-02: No rustdoc names a removed method, and the validation suites pass.

## Notes

- Behaviour is unchanged.
- Written against the code as it stands after the changes this one follows; line citations name current code.
title: Remove the executor-side validation pass copies
